name: Pouilly-Fumé

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Sauvignon Blanc sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

notes: Pouilly-Fumé is a dry Sauvignon Blanc from around Pouilly-sur-Loire.
It tastes of gooseberry and grapefruit and is usually fuller bodied and richer than other Loire Sauvignon.
It is one of the few Sauvignon Blancs with aging potential.

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation around Pouilly-sur-Loire in Nièvre for dry white wine made from Sauvignon Blanc.
